purpose: One controlled native-input/presentation method trial; not H01 workload benchmark
sharedFixture: Existing disposable GUI37 single-page saved Space and common UI/Core; no real vault
procedure: Explicitly reopen saved candidate with launcher37 --reopen and leave it open
Start controller and wait for RECORDING STARTED on terminal
Click in View A text, ensure no text range is selected, and type lowercase a, then b, then c, about two seconds apart
Leave the window open while the twenty-second recording ends and finalizes

input.interval: approximately two seconds, not a timed benchmark instruction

evidenceRequiredBeforeMetrics: Trace contains the actual input events and unambiguous target editor/render process association
Frame/surface records resolve to the candidate document rather than unrelated OS windows
Trace units/clocks and input-to-presentation event joining demonstrated from raw definitions
Missing/sentinel fields and unrelated frames excluded with explicit reasons, no nearest-frame guessing
bound: One method trial per eligible candidate; if native input/producer/presentation linkage is absent, mark H11 blocked with exact missing field/instrument. No repeated idle captures or unbounded table fishing.
failurePolicy: Preserve all raw attempts; no lowered gate, sudo/private API or JS/RAF timing substitute. Use common instrumentation seam only if a concrete missing observable requires it; separately hash and apply equally before comparison.
